messages.en:

free, you wanna go for a
walk with me, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

It's gonna be VERY trendy!
{07 0d 00}And, it costs nothing, so
it's perfect for you,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}Hei, {04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}kui sa oled

jalutamine hakkab
plahvatama!{01 00 00 05 00} See tuleb VÄGA

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Once in a while, it's good
to have a day where you
just recharge!
{07 06 00}Gotta charge up so I can
turn on the afterburners
if there's a big sale!

{07 14 00}Aeg-ajalt on hea, kui on
päev, mil sa lihtsalt
laed end täis!
{07 06 00}Pean end laadima, et saaks
täiskäigule minna,
kui on suur soodusmüük!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Look, I'll be honest:{01 00 00 05 00} I get
super psyched about a lot
of things...
But when I'm relaxed and
walking around...

{07 13 00}I slowly get super psyched
about walking around, too!{01 00 00 05 00}
Cute, huh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 13 00}siis lähen ma tasapisi
